# robust-outliers

> Robust outlier detection with modified z-scores from the median absolute deviation, Tukey fences on inclusive quartiles and a Hampel filter for series, with explicit bounds Python package `trysac-robust-outliers`, import name `robust_outliers`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
